An early '''skirmish''' of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] occurred over [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="Xwing" /> in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]]<ref name="Date" /> between two [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilots]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]] and three pairs of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] [[TIE pilot|pilots]] of [[Alpha Squadron|Alpha]], [[Beta Squadron/Legends|Beta]], and [[Gamma Squadron/Legends|Gamma Squadrons]].<ref name="Xwing" />

The engagement was later simulated as a training mission by the Rebel Alliance, intended to teach prospective [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] to work as a team with their [[Wingmate/Legends|wingmates]].<ref name="Xwing" /> [[Agamarian]] Rebel [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] was assigned to the simulation by [[Training officer/Legends|training officer]] [[Wex Dafid]] prior to Farlander's recruitment into the Alliance [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']]{{'s}} Red Squadron.<ref name="XWOSG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle first appeared in the [[1993]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']] as the second X-wing historical mission, "Wingmen are important."<ref name="Xwing" />
